name: proof-looping
description: Turn "my app + an agent that demos" into "benchmarked, browser-verified, evidence-backed, prod-proven, and looping." Use when a (solo) founder wants to prove an AI agent works IN their real app — across all its UI surfaces — without cheating. Triggers: "set up proofloop", "proof-loop my app", "benchmark my agent's UI", "prove my agent works in prod", "run proofloop". The user's coding agent (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor) drives; the user steers by comment.
